svg.title: permute
svg.desc: Two hands riffle-shuffling a single deck of teal-backed cards above the permute wordmark, inside a navy and ivory hexagon.
svg.metadata: Approved permute logo, 2026. All artwork and lettering are vector paths. Palette: navy #082443; ivory #FFF2D5; teal #0C9493; skin #FDC393; shadow #E9956B; nail #FDD9B9.
